content.text:
@Image1 is Eamon: Elderly man, thin, weathered skin, grey hair cropped short, sharp jaw, kind blue eyes, wearing Heavy wool peacoat, dark blue sweater, worn leather boots; A brass compass on a chain around his neck, always glowing faintly. Keep this exact face, hair and outfit.
@Image2 is Vael: Personification of a storm: a swirling vortex of dark clouds, with fleeting, luminous blue eyes and crackling lightning veins, wearing None, just shifting cloud forms; Eyes of lightning that flicker and a constant low rumbling presence. Keep this exact face, hair and outfit.
Each referenced person appears exactly once in frame.
The storm arrives, sentient and curious, causing the light to flicker. Location: Lighthouse gallery, night, Night, stormy.
[0s–6s] Hero sees dark clouds churning on the horizon, wind intensifies, and he grips the railing.
[6s–12s] Storm vortex forms near the lighthouse, sparks of lightning reveal its swirling shape and eyes.
[12s–18s] Storm reaches out a tendril of cloud toward the lamp, causing the light to flicker erratically.
[18s–24s] Hero braces against the wind, holding his compass, staring at the sentient storm.
Camera: Static wide shot of the gallery, then quick zoom to the storm's forming face, handheld shake during the tendril reach.
Continuity: Same gallery, lamp now lit and casting a beam, heavy rain drenching hero's coat, compass glowing brighter.
Audio: Thunder crashes, storm's rumbling voice, scattered piano notes, lighthouse mechanism groans. Dialogue: [14s–17s] @Image1 says "What are you?" (Gruff but gentle, soft-spoken.); [18s–21s] @Image2 says "I am the wind." (Echoing, layered whispers like wind.). No subtitles or on-screen text.
Style: Hand-drawn animation with watercolour textures, reminiscent of a graphic novel. Deep blues, teal, and warm amber light. Soft, diffused lighting with glowing edges. The lighthouse beam cuts through mist. Early 20th century, rustic, isolated. Non-photorealistic, painterly rendering.
